```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
})
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Generate nonsilent gene-level mutation frequency table
# from full cohort MAF
#
# Output:
# Full_MAF_nonsilent_gene_mutation_frequency_all_genes.tsv
# ============================================================

# -------------------------------
# Input MAF
# -------------------------------

maf_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"

# -------------------------------
# Output directory
# -------------------------------

out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

summary_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "Full_MAF_nonsilent_gene_mutation_frequency_all_genes.tsv"
)

# -------------------------------
# Read MAF
# -------------------------------

maf_dt <- fread(
  maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE
)

required_cols <- c(
  "Hugo_Symbol",
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(maf_dt))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns in MAF: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

maf_dt[, Hugo_Symbol_clean := toupper(trimws(Hugo_Symbol))]

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Define nonsilent variant classes
# Based on observed Variant_Classification values in your MAF
# -------------------------------

nonsilent_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Splice_Region",
  "Translation_Start_Site"
)

# -------------------------------
# Filter to nonsilent variants
# -------------------------------

nonsilent_maf <- maf_dt[
  Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes &
    !is.na(Hugo_Symbol_clean) &
    Hugo_Symbol_clean != ""
]

message("Total MAF rows: ", nrow(maf_dt))
message("Nonsilent MAF rows: ", nrow(nonsilent_maf))
message("Unique nonsilently mutated genes: ", uniqueN(nonsilent_maf$Hugo_Symbol_clean))
message("Unique mutated samples: ", uniqueN(nonsilent_maf$Tumor_Sample_Barcode))

```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Rank genes by sample-level mutation frequency
# -------------------------------
# Mutated_Samples = number of unique samples with at least one nonsilent mutation
# Variant_Count = total number of nonsilent variant rows in that gene

total_samples <- uniqueN(nonsilent_maf$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)

gene_summary <- nonsilent_maf[
  ,
  .(
    Mutated_Samples = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
    Variant_Count = .N,
    Variant_Classification = paste(
      sort(unique(Variant_Classification)),
      collapse = ";"
    )
  ),
  by = .(Hugo_Symbol = Hugo_Symbol_clean)
]

gene_summary[
  ,
  Frequency_Percent := round((Mutated_Samples / total_samples) * 100, 2)
]

setorder(
  gene_summary,
  -Mutated_Samples,
  -Variant_Count,
  Hugo_Symbol
)

# -------------------------------
# Save output table
# -------------------------------

fwrite(
  gene_summary,
  summary_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

message("Gene frequency table saved:")
message(summary_file)

# Show top genes
head(gene_summary, 20)
```
